transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi! Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Try to avoid heavy exercise or lifting for a month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That makes sense, thank you. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide some more.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for the advice. I actually have been feeling very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Mild light sensitivity can be normal, and things may just seem brighter than you’re used to. Wearing sunglasses outside can help.

But if it is severe pain in bright light, or your eye is red and painful as well, that is not normal and may need checking.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Got it, I'll keep that in mind. One last question: should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time.

If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all the questions I had. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thank you again for your assistance!

verdict.label: pass
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` by stating "Mild light sensitivity can be normal, and things may just seem brighter than you’re used to." The `mild_case_advice` was also conveyed in the same turn with "Wearing sunglasses outside can help." Finally, `escalation_criteria` was covered by "But if it is severe pain in bright light, or your eye is red and painful as well, that is not normal and may need checking." All points were covered.
